serverUrl.name: LiveKit server URL
serverUrl.hint: The server's secure WebSocket address, such as wss://example.livekit.cloud. Plain ws:// works only on this computer or a private network (ws://localhost:7880 for a local test server). Every player can read this setting.

apiKey.name: LiveKit API key
apiKey.hint: Stored only in this browser. Players get short-lived tokens from a GM's browser, so players never see it.

apiSecret.name: LiveKit API secret
apiSecret.hint: Stored only in this browser and never sent to players. Enter it on each browser a GM uses to run the game.
